tactics.title: Take laser within ~8–15s; fight only after armed
tactics.fit: ARM mode; prefer laser like house:expert / probe-red-best
procedure: expert medFirstWeaponT=5.2 firstWeapon={'laser': 5, 'mortar': 2, 'lightning': 2}
probe-red-best medFirstWeaponT=9.7 firstWeapon={'laser': 4, 'mortar': 0, 'lightning': 2}
Spawn → nearest laser loot; lightning only if laser >~80m.
Exit ARM on laser take; allow crate/drone gun poke before secondary.
tactics.change_first: Hard-prefer laser in ARM loot ranking; exit ARM immediately on laser take.

tactics.title: Roof as short staging (≈10–25% time), laser peek 50–70m, then relocate
tactics.fit: S1 roof camp — soften with peek-timeout, do not delete S1 for practice
procedure: expert meanRoofPct=38.1 roofAfterArm=0.0 firstRoofT=11.25
engage range med≈56.97m; boost≈28.2%
After arm: climb ≤15s, one laser cycle, leave if no isolate / after ~8s empty.
Winners keep inZone≈100 and stay mobile — not AFK roof camps.
tactics.change_first: Add CAMP peek-timeout → RELOCATE after laser cycle with no target.

tactics.title: Hard DISENGAGE when 2+ mechs hit within ~3s
tactics.fit: DISENGAGE mode; multiAttackerPct is the mid-pack death signature
procedure: expert meanMulti=19.9; top places often multi≪30%
Trigger on ≥2 mech damage sources in 2.5s OR dmgIn spike >250/2s.
Boost perpendicular + break LOS; no greed laser finish.
Re-enter FIGHT only if ≤1 aggressor and HP≥45%.
tactics.change_first: Lower multi-source DISENGAGE threshold; forbid THIRD while multi flag set.
